description: How a new savegame starts and what the game does when a map is entered straight from boot. save_init: a fresh save's starting values (enemy_state_count slots of enemy state all set to enemy_state_value, -1 = alive; start_paper_map: the page number of paper_maps.json opened first, 1 = OldTown; difficulty_min / difficulty_max: the range the chosen difficulty is clamped into). map_entry: tutorial_maps never get the entry gates; start_loadout is the gear given to a New Game booted directly onto a map chosen in config (normally the intro hands it over): items go to inventory slots 0.. in order (item names of items/), equipped is the weapon held, toggle_set / toggle_clear are item toggle flags (radio_on, flashlight_off). A mod replaces the file; keys it leaves out keep the built-in values.
